chapters.label: Live: the 2021 final
chapters.text: The 2021 Futsal Champions League final. Barcelona lead Sporting two nil. Then Tomás Paçó, just twenty, plays it across. Zicky Té controls it and rolls it in. Two one!

chapters.label: Replay: the calm pass
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Tomás takes his time. He finds Zicky, who is free, and passes it across. Zicky controls it, and scores. A calm pass!

chapters.label: Full time
chapters.text: Sporting keep attacking. From two nil down, they win four three. Champions of Europe!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. Stay calm on the ball. Look up, and pass to the teammate who is free!
